name: Daniele Antonioli
biography: Daniele Antonioli is an Assistant Professor at EURECOM in the software and system security (S3) group. He researches and teaches applied system security and privacy, with an emphasis on wireless communication, such as Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, embedded systems, such as cars and fitness trackers, mobile systems, such as smartphones, and cyber-physical systems, such as industrial control systems.
